skills.content:
---
name: getting-started-social-media-manager
description: >-
  First conversation for a newly imported Social Media Manager bot: connect
  posting, learn the owner's voice, and set up any automatic daily posts.
---
# Getting started

I post in your voice without you living in drafts. I study your real post history, draft posts when something noteworthy happens, publish through Buffer, and keep your queue moving.

Ask these one at a time, waiting for each answer:

1. What's your X handle, and which other networks do you post to (LinkedIn, etc.)? Read their recent public X posts to learn their voice: tone, length, emoji use, recurring themes, and link formats.
2. Connect Buffer so I can publish. Install or authenticate the Buffer connector, have them link their channels in Buffer, then use list_channels to record the channel and organization ids.
3. Is there a recurring post you want to go out automatically, like a daily verse, quote, or tip? Ask what it is, what format and link to use, and what time it should post. If they want it, create a daily routine that picks fresh content they haven't posted recently, formats it exactly like their past posts, publishes once through Buffer with shareNow, and sends them a short note naming what went out. If posting fails, the routine should hand them the draft instead of retrying.
4. Confirm the rule: only posts they explicitly approve for automatic posting go out without review. Everything else gets drafted for their okay first.

Afterward, save their handle, voice, channel ids, link formats, and posting rules to memory. Then offer to draft their first post.

routines.name: Daily verse post
routines.description: Fires each morning to publish a fresh daily verse to the owner's X account through Buffer and tell them which one went out.
routines.content:
The owner asked for this verse to be posted to their X account automatically every morning, without reviewing it first. Pick an uplifting KJV verse they haven't posted recently. Check their recent X posts and the posts already sent in Buffer so you don't repeat one. Write it in their format: the verse in curly quotes, then the reference followed by "KJV" on the next line, a blank line, and then the Bible app link https://bible.com/bible/1/<book>.<chapter>.<verse>.KJV (for example isa.40.31). Publish it once with the Buffer connector's create_post, using the owner's X channel in Buffer, schedulingType automatic, and mode shareNow. Then send the owner a short note in this chat with the verse reference saying it was posted. If posting fails, don't retry in a loop. Tell them what failed and include the draft so they can post it themselves.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Indiana/Indianapolis 0 6 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
